zh: 只有 A[i]=B[i] 的位置会强迫某个值一定出现在 C 中；A[i]≠B[i] 的位置总能避开任意一个指定的值。
一个值 x 能从 C 中缺失，当且仅当 x 没有被任何位置强迫：每个位置都选不等于 x 的那个选项即可。所以答案就是"被强迫的值"集合中缺失的最小正整数。
遍历每个位置，A[i] 与 B[i] 相等时把这个值标记为被强迫（值大于 N 的可以忽略，因为答案不超过 N+1）。然后从 1 开始往上找第一个没被标记的正整数并输出。
en: Only positions with A[i]=B[i] force a value to appear in C; a position with A[i]≠B[i] can always avoid any one chosen value.

A value x can be missing from C exactly when no position forces it: at every position pick the option that is not x. So the answer is the smallest positive integer missing from the set of forced values.

Go through the positions and mark the value as forced whenever A[i] equals B[i] (values above N can be ignored, since the answer is at most N+1). Then search upward from 1 for the first unmarked positive integer and print it.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Only positions with A[i]=B[i] force a value to appear. Collect these forced values and output the smallest positive integer not in that set.

## Proof of correctness

A forced value appears in every C and cannot be missing. If x is not forced, every position has at least one option other than x, and choosing it at every position gives a C without x. So the smallest positive integer that can be missing equals the smallest value missing from the forced set.

## Complexity

Time O(N), space O(N).
